_comment: Postcards from space (spec: UI rules, Postcards). Real NASA pictures, public domain, from the NASA Image and Video Library (nasaId). Each unlocks when that share of the science goal has reached Earth. Captions come from the NASA description; anything added from general knowledge is marked to verify. Images are resized copies in public/postcards/.

caption.value: NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter took this picture of Earth from its orbit around the Moon.
caption.source: NASA Image and Video Library, GSFC_20171208_Archive_e000496 (caption from its description)

unlockAt.source: Game rule (Postcards): the first science data to reach Earth

caption.value: Sunrise on the central peak of Tycho crater, seen by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter. Tycho is about 82 km wide, and its peak rises about 2 km above the crater floor.
caption.source: NASA Image and Video Library, GSFC_20171208_Archive_e001873 (caption from its description)

caption.value: The Apollo 11 landing site, seen by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter in 2009. The labels mark the Eagle lander’s descent stage and the experiments the astronauts left behind.
